name: imgpreview-dropzone

frames.best_why: Frame 6 shows the dashed zone together with two uploaded thumbnails; the first two frames show the empty zone only.

tagline: Drop images into a dashed box and see square previews appear below.
summary: A dashed upload box for images that lists picked files as small square thumbnails underneath. Each can be removed, and the upload is capped at four files of 1MB.
appearance: A wide dashed-border rounded rectangle on near-black, holding a small upload cloud icon and two lines of centred text. Below it sit two square image thumbnails with rounded corners, each with a small corner remove button.
behaviour: Dragging files over the zone or clicking it opens the picture picker; chosen images appear as small square previews beneath the box, each with an X to remove. Up to four files of 1MB are accepted.
demo_content: Two blue and orange gradient sample images
search_phrases: upload photos and see small previews
attach images with drag and drop
use_when: Users attach a few photos and should see what they picked before submitting.
avoid_when: Hard limit of four files and 1MB each, with no message explaining a rejection.
customise: Nothing is exposed: the accepted formats, the four-file and 1MB limits and the copy are fixed in the file.
weight_why: A drop zone and a few thumbnails; no loops or heavy libraries.

a11y.note: The upload copy is styled text rather than a form label; thumbnails do carry the file name through alt text.

issues: No error message appears when a file is rejected for size or type.
polish_why: Clean, legible drop zone; plain thumbnails and no rejection feedback keep it ordinary.
title: Image Preview Dropzone
